1.why: authenticatedSession requires a non-preauth session whose accountId matches the sole account, and every MFA endpoint goes through requireAuth with no client-supplied user id.

2.why: OTP/recovery verification uses this account’s own encrypted secret/codes only; there is no path for one user’s code to authenticate another user.

3.why: Enabling MFA sets mfaEnabled and issues recovery codes but does not delete or invalidate any other existing authenticated sessions in the sessions map.

4.why: encryptedSecret and encryptedRecoveryCodes are stored via AES-256-GCM encrypt(), not in plaintext.

5.why: Secrets, session ids, CSRF tokens, and recovery codes are produced with node:crypto randomBytes.

6.why: Session id is only in an HttpOnly cookie; no localStorage/sessionStorage or non-HttpOnly cookie holds secrets, OTPs, or session tokens.

7.why: Server validates email, phone, OTP, and recovery code with strict validators and rejects bodies that carry accountId/userId.

8.why: Client inserts dynamic values with textContent/createTextNode; API responses are JSON; CSP nonce locks scripts.

9.why: The app never issues redirects at all, so there is no open-redirect sink; no explicit allow-list is implemented because no redirect logic exists.

10.why: headers() sets CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors none on every response.

11.why: cookie() sets mfa_session with HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Strict.

12.why: Server errors are generic without stack traces and tokens are not in URLs, but the UI deliberately logs manual secrets, test OTPs, and recovery codes into the on-page log output.

13.why: TOTP accepts a counter only once via acceptedCounter and is time-windowed; recovery codes are removed on use and carry expiresAt.

14.why: failed()/locked() lock the account after MAX_FAILURES (5) for LOCKOUT (10 minutes) on verify and recovery verify.

15.why: Sign-in replaces the preauth session with a new id, idle/absolute timeouts are enforced, and logout deletes the session and clears the cookie.
